Summary

PRVENR01 is a batch provider enrollment loader program that reads provider applications from a sequential intake file, validates each application (checking for NPI, provider type, and taxonomy), and writes approved pending provider records to the Provider Master indexed file (KSDS). Invalid applications are written to a sequential error file for reporting. This is a Main/Driver program as it contains STOP RUN and no Linkage Section parameters passed from a calling program.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed), Sequential Files - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Batch Initialization - Initialize the enrollment load process by setting the program identifier, resetting all record counters (read, written, skipped, errored) to zero, opening the provider application intake file, provider master file, and error file, and accepting or defaulting the batch identifier for tracking purposes 2: Provider Application Reading - Sequentially read each provider application record from the intake file into a working storage area, incrementing the records-read counter for each successfully read record, and detecting end-of-file to stop processing 3: NPI Presence Validation - Check that the provider's National Provider Identifier (NPI) is not blank or missing; if the NPI is absent, flag the application as invalid, increment the error counter, and route the application to error recording 4: Provider Type Classification Validation - Verify that the provider application contains a recognized provider type designation (Individual, Group, or Facility); if none of these types is indicated, flag the application as invalid, increment the error counter, and route to error recording 5: Provider Taxonomy Code Validation - Confirm that the provider's taxonomy code (specialty/classification code) is populated and not blank; if missing, flag the application as invalid, increment the error counter, and route to error recording 6: Provider Enrollment Status Assignment - For applications that pass all validations, set the provider's enrollment status to PENDING and screening status to UNSCREENED, marking the provider as awaiting review and background screening before full enrollment 7: Validation Error Record Writing - For each application that fails any validation check, write a detailed error record to the error output file containing the provider NPI, provider type code, and a validation-failed indicator for downstream review and correction 8: Invalid Application Written to Provider Master (Defect) - Due to a missing exit in the INVALID-APP paragraph, provider applications that have FAILED validation (missing NPI, invalid type, or missing taxonomy) also fall through and are written to the provider master file as PENDING records, making them eligible for auto-approval and potential improper enrollment 9: Provider Master Record Writing - Write the provider record (whether valid or invalid due to fall-through defect) to the Provider Master KSDS file; handle outcomes including successful write (increment written counter), duplicate NPI detection (increment skipped counter and log the duplicate NPI), or write failure (increment error counter and set error return code) 10: Batch Completion Reporting and Return Code Setting - Close all files, display final counts of records read, written, errored, and skipped for the batch run, and set a warning return code if any errors were encountered during processing to signal downstream jobs

Datasource Information (3)

Datasource Name Type Usage
APP-INPUT-FILE Sequential File Input - Reads provider enrollment application records for processing and validation
PRV-MASTER-FILE VSAM KSDS (Indexed File) Input/Output - Writes validated (and due to a bug, also invalid) provider records as PENDING enrollment entries to the Provider Master file
APP-ERROR-FILE Sequential File Output - Writes error detail records for provider applications that fail validation (missing NPI, invalid provider type, or missing taxonomy)

READ APP-INPUT-FILE INTO WS-PRV-WORK MOVE WS-APP-IN-STATUS TO WS-FILE-STATUS IF WS-FS-EOF SET WS-END-OF-FILE TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-FS-OK ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-READ PERFORM VALIDATE-APPLICATION ELSE DISPLAY 'PRVENR01: READ ERROR ' WS-APP-IN-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-ERRORED MOVE 8 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF END-IF. ``` NPI Mandatory Presence Validation-L_42-48: ```cobol IF PRV-NPI OF WS-PRV-WORK = SPACES MOVE EC-MISSING-NPI TO WS-FILE-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-ERRORED PERFORM WRITE-ERROR-RECORD GO TO INVALID-APP END-IF ``` Provider Type Classification Validation-L_49-55: ```cobol IF NOT PRV-INDIVIDUAL OF WS-PRV-WORK AND NOT PRV-GROUP OF WS-PRV-WORK AND NOT PRV-FACILITY OF WS-PRV-WORK ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-ERRORED PERFORM WRITE-ERROR-RECORD GO TO INVALID-APP END-IF ``` Provider Taxonomy Code Mandatory Presence Validation-L_56-61: ```cobol IF PRV-TAXONOMY OF WS-PRV-WORK = SPACES ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-ERRORED PERFORM WRITE-ERROR-RECORD GO TO INVALID-APP END-IF ``` Validation Error Record Logging-L_80-87: ```cobol WRITE-ERROR-RECORD. STRING PRV-NPI OF WS-PRV-WORK DELIMITED SIZE ' TYPE:' DELIMITED SIZE PRV-TYPE-CODE OF WS-PRV-WORK DELIMITED SIZE ' ERR:VALIDATION-FAILED' DELIMITED SIZE INTO WS-ERR-DETAIL WRITE APP-ERROR-RECORD FROM WS-ERR-DETAIL. ``` Validated Provider Enrollment Status Assignment-L_62-65: ```cobol SET PRV-PENDING OF WS-PRV-WORK TO TRUE SET PRV-UNSCREENED OF WS-PRV-WORK TO TRUE PERFORM WRITE-PROVIDER-RECORD. ``` Provider Master Record Write Outcome Handling-L_68-79: ```cobol WRITE-PROVIDER-RECORD. MOVE WS-PRV-WORK TO PRV-MASTER-RECORD WRITE PRV-MASTER-RECORD EVALUATE WS-PRV-OUT-STATUS WHEN '00' ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-WRITTEN WHEN '22' DISPLAY 'PRVENR01: DUPLICATE NPI ' PRV-NPI OF WS-PRV-WORK ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-SKIPPED WHEN OTHER DISPLAY 'PRVENR01: WRITE ERROR ' WS-PRV-OUT-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-ERRORED MOVE 8 TO RETURN-CODE END-EVALUATE. ``` Batch Completion Reporting and Warning Signal-L_89-99: ```cobol TERMINATE-PROGRAM. CLOSE APP-INPUT-FILE PRV-MASTER-FILE APP-ERROR-FILE DISPLAY 'PRVENR01: READ=' WS-RECORDS-READ DISPLAY 'PRVENR01: WRITTEN=' WS-RECORDS-WRITTEN DISPLAY 'PRVENR01: ERRORS=' WS-RECORDS-ERRORED DISPLAY 'PRVENR01: SKIPPED=' WS-RECORDS-SKIPPED IF WS-RECORDS-ERRORED > ZEROS MOVE 4 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF. ```
